per_case.question: For a 750-employee US services company considering a 12-week generative-AI rollout across HR, support, engineering, finance, and marketing, what evidence would establish net productivity, quality, cost, equity, and safety effects against a staggered-control design, and which outcomes should gate expansion?

For a 24-analyst public-health research unit completing 300 descriptive analyses per quarter, does a generative-AI data-analysis copilot improve reproducible, independently checked analyses per analyst-week compared with current scripts and peer support without increasing coding, interpretation, or privacy errors?

In a 1,000-employee professional-services firm with 20,000 internal knowledge queries monthly, does a retrieval-grounded generative-AI assistant reduce employee search time and improve answer accuracy relative to the existing intranet search without increasing unsupported or stale-policy answers?

For a 500-employee US manufacturer processing 6,000 invoices monthly, does AI-assisted invoice extraction and exception routing reduce cost and cycle time per correctly paid invoice versus the current accounts-payable process while preserving approval controls and fraud detection?

At a 25-person B2B marketing team publishing 40 technical articles monthly, does a human-edited generative-AI drafting workflow improve publication throughput and qualified organic conversions per editor-hour versus the existing workflow without reducing factual accuracy or brand quality?

For a 35-person SaaS sales team contacting 8,000 qualified leads monthly, does generative-AI account research and email personalization increase held qualified meetings per eligible lead versus the current sales sequence, net of research, editing, and compliance time?

At a 60-engineer product company, does access to an AI coding copilot increase independently reviewed, production-accepted work per engineer-week over 12 weeks without raising rework, security defects, or code-review burden?

For a 120-agent customer-support center handling 50,000 monthly tickets, does an agent-facing generative-AI reply assistant improve resolution time and customer satisfaction compared with the same agents without suggestions, after accounting for case mix and escalation?

In a 200-employee startup onboarding 30 customer-support hires per quarter, does a generative-AI onboarding assistant shorten time to independent work and improve 90-day retention versus the existing mentor-led program without increasing policy errors?

For a 200-employee US software startup hiring 40 engineers and customer-support staff over six months, does an AI-assisted résumé screen reduce recruiter time-to-shortlist without worsening job-relevant selection quality or adverse impact?

interpretation_limits: Candidate occurrences are not unique papers; the same record can appear in multiple queries or jobs.
Nonselected candidate abstracts are not present in the saved runtime snapshot, so the title-only pass count is not a replay of the full discovery gate.
Selected records have saved abstracts; rejection counts are deterministic filter outcomes, not human relevance judgments.
No precision, recall, false-positive rate, or scientific quality score can be calculated without reviewed labels.

manual_regression_examples.false_positive_blocked: The sPHENIX fast-data-processing/detector-control title previously passed via generic AI, processing and time overlap; the query-context filter now rejects it.
manual_regression_examples.adjacent_synonym_recovered: Designing and Evaluating Generative AI Search Tools for Human Cognitive Augmentation now passes a knowledge-retrieval query via direct title term search plus generative-AI intervention match; the paper's topical adequacy remains unverified because its abstract was not in that snapshot.
